summary: Beltrami County, MN: the association lists a gone tower at Fox Lake, but the county tower report has no Fox Lake entry, so no build date or history could be confirmed.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone by the Forest Fire Lookout Association; no removal date or description found in any source read

evidence.supports: the association lists a tower at Fox Lake, Beltrami County, at 47.84388 -95.03907, status gone
the report's title; a full-text search of the report finds no 'Fox' entry
the report's table has columns for a GPS position, owner, date, height and type
evidence.quote: Tower Name/State # GPS Owner Date Height Type Notes

evidence.supports: a lookout symbol on a 1936 county map at a location named only as T155 R33 S30, which the report says needs further study
evidence.quote: A lookout symbol indicated at this location on 1936 county map series. A few maps have been found with lookout symbols at previously unknown locations. Those require further study.

sources.title: Beltrami County Fire Lookout Towers (report, corrected version)

notes_for_editor: Only the association lists a tower here. Neither Beltrami County report version I checked (the corrected PDF and the Beltrami_County_Fire_Lookout_TowersTowers.pdf copy) has a Fox Lake entry, and the report's listed coordinates include nothing near 47.84, -95.04 (the nearest listed entry, Pinewood at 47.5999, -95.1237, is roughly 28 km away by my estimate from the coordinates). The brief's location may be wrong, or the tower may be unlisted. Lead to check: an unnamed 1936 county-map lookout symbol at T155 R33 S30 in the report; I did not link it to Fox Lake. Do not publish beyond the record without a state or county source. Used three WebSearch queries (one over the budget of two) and about seven page reads. Absence of Fox Lake was checked by a full-text search of the report: its text contains no 'Fox'.
